I own this land, so I will put some manure there and I will also buy some fertilizer if I get it in time, but I will not spend too much because cash is tight and sorghum can still stand better than maize when rain is not good. I will keep my local seed because that is what I know on this intercropped plot, and I will use herbicide once to reduce the weeding work.
